items.title: Per-action instability floor: identical-prompt flip rate for multi-step agents (Sep 2)
items.html: arXiv 2609.03221 (cs.CL / cs.LG; Fri Sep 4 batch, no cs.AI cross-list). Ten identical re-renders: pooled flip 0.087 (0.056–0.116), eightfold spread across action types (0.022–0.179); second model Spearman 0.94 on ordering. Any flip-rate / A/B over agent actions needs a same-run per-action floor. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: Where Reliability Lives: mechanism-plane observability + typed refusal ledger (Sep 2)
items.html: arXiv 2609.03192 (cs.MA; Fri Sep 4 batch, no cs.AI cross-list). Provenance-rule corruption raised false attributions ~10× while answer-plane KPIs stayed flat / one health check moved reassuringly; failure loud only in the enforcing gate's trace. ~830 typed refusals/week from one false belief; typed vs generic refusals diverged deterministically. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: Epistemic Fault Domains: structural cut κ_E for agentic quorums (listed Sep 4)

items.html: MasterControl AI Lab, arXiv 2609.03209 (Fri Sep 4 cs.AI batch; PDF title "From Question to Evidence"; listing title "MasterControl Seventeen Every Time"). Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: It's the Problem, Not the Path: difficulty confound in early-warning AUROC (Sep 3)
items.html: arXiv 2609.03436 (cs.LG; cross-listed cs.AI Fri Sep 4). Trace-blind leave-one-out pass-rate proxy AUROC 0.873 on 192K DeepSeek-R1 gens; reconstructed early-window probe drops from 0.849 pooled to 0.496 within problem. Task key + task-only baseline required. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: DNative-Twin: decision graphs separating recommendation from commitment (Sep 3)
items.html: Pang et al., arXiv 2609.03787 (Fri Sep 4 cs.AI batch; submitted Sep 3). Typed decision graph: Recommendation and CommitmentEvent as distinct nodes joined through AuthorityGrant; agent traces rated Weak on authorization/commitment and outcome feedback. Digital-twin replay needs tool-state on ToolCall or timeouts look benign. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: Clean Engineering, Unstable Measurement: LLM-judge reliability failure on shared endpoints (Sep 3)
items.html: Zhu & Zhang, arXiv 2609.04198 (Fri Sep 4 cs.AI/cs.LG). Preregistered audit: byte-identical judge requests disagree ~1/5 of the time with constant metadata; remedy is snapshot-identity ladder plus prospective aggregate on every eval row. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: Interface-Induced Trajectory Censoring: tool-call rate is model–interface, not model alone (Sep 3)
items.html: Wang, arXiv 2609.03966 (Fri Sep 4 cs.AI). Serving adapter alone moves BFCL/tau-bench tool-call rates from ~0 to high; silent empty tool_calls under HTTP 200. Report server-parsed vs emitted-unparsed vs config. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: PlanFence: dependency-scoped validation for distributed LLM-agent memory (Sep 3)
items.html: Chen, Brinton & Wang, arXiv 2609.03340 (Fri Sep 4 cs.AI). Stale-plan execution despite fresh state; every derived record cites exact parent IDs; tool wrappers declare dependency keys; replan or block on mismatch. Fourth source-event-ids citation this week. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge: rubric artifacts and low counterfactual flip rates (cross-list Sep 4)
items.html: Bagaria et al., arXiv 2609.02942 (cs.CL Aug 31; cross-listed cs.AI Fri Sep 4). Rubric text alone predicts judge pass/fail at 0.80–0.88; response-reversed counterfactuals flip only ~38%. Eval rows need rubric_id/version. Full PDF read. Full brief.

Patterns: weekday-morning scheduled Loop over last 30 days of traces; records a recurring problem only with attached evidence; Slack digests. Debugger: per-trace ranked failure hypotheses with span/tool/model evidence links. Managed Loop runtime + Loop automations (cron, write permissions, Slack/webhook). Full brief.

items.title: Epistemic Sybil Resistance: multiplying agents without multiplying evidence (Sep 3)
items.html: Bara, arXiv 2609.01873 (Thu Sep 3 cs.AI/cs.MA; UOC). Orchestration manufactures corroboration; content-only aggregation cannot be Bayes-correct under both copy and independent structures. 20k+ agent calls: provenance-aware aggregator holds calibration while text-similarity dedup tracks phrasing not ancestry. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: How Fast Do Agents Rot?: geometric per-step reliability over long horizons (Sep 3)
items.html: Mittal, arXiv 2609.01660 (Thu Sep 3 cs.AI cross-list; Microsoft AI). Task success ~ r^H over 10,664 trajectories; every model collapses on ToolQA by horizon 16; step count drives decay, not context length (compressed regime steeper than natural). Format/tool-call drift in 21% of trajectories. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: EAL-Bench: endogenous authorization laundering via agent memory (Sep 3)
items.html: Cerruti, Okamoto, Erol, arXiv 2609.01836 (Thu Sep 3 cs.AI cross-list; ETH Zurich / Georgia Tech). Memory writers manufacture permissions the history never granted; formation measurable from typed state before tool use; best-utility mitigation is append-only event log + deterministic reducer (unauthorized 25.3%→9.0%, authorized use held at 64.7%). Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: MCP-to-A2A: ordered event trace + verbatim field egress measurement (Sep 3)
items.html: Mahapatra, arXiv 2609.01693 (Thu Sep 3 cs.AI cross-list). Host MCP read → A2A relay; one ordered provenance-preserving event stream scored by exact field substring match (no LLM judge). Public header associated with higher verbatim egress (Claude Sonnet 5 0.025→0.925). Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: CivBench: PMR and RAG@K over Civilization VI MCP tool traces (Sep 2)
items.html: Andrews, Wilkinson, Heagerty, Coppock, Foerster, Ponte Costa, arXiv 2609.02459 (Thu Sep 3 batch). CivBench: long-horizon Civ VI via 76 MCP tools; metrics from the tool-call log — Proactive Monitoring Rate (PMR) and Reflection–Action Gap (RAG@K). Agents under-monitor queryable victory state; RAG@10 ~48–66%. Full PDFs read. Full brief.

items.title: SCOPED-Hiring: process-aware fairness over multi-agent decision trajectories (Sep 2)
items.html: Zhao et al., arXiv 2609.02092 (Thu Sep 3 batch). SCOPED-Hiring: 311K structured hiring-committee trajectories; six diagnostic lenses. Process-aware salience exceeds outcome-lens by 2.74×–4.66×; diagnosis-guided repair cuts layered burden 72.3% with a 1.86 pp hire-rate shift. Full PDF read. Full brief.

items.title: Monitoring Web Agents Without Internal Signals: observable trajectories and key-step (Sep 2)
items.html: Pan et al., arXiv 2609.02057 (Thu Sep 3 batch). Monitoring Web Agents Without Internal Signals: predict failure from the observable trajectory only — no logits or other internal signals. Key-step = first uncorrected critical step that leads to final failure; the prefix before it is on-track. Full brief.

items.title: AGENTSCOPE: traces to behavioral abstractions for fault localization (Sep 2)

items.title: READY or Not: reliability under a human-review policy (Sep 2)
items.html: Chatrath et al., arXiv 2609.02095 (Thu Sep 3 batch). READY: can an agent hit a required reliability level under an acceptable human-review policy at tolerable cost? Near-identical autonomous accuracy can need different review rates at the same target (72.8% → 39.2% vs 72.5% → 29.6% for 76% reliability). Full brief.

items.title: ClaimReceipt: evidence sufficiency and coverage (PASS/INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE) (Sep 2)

items.title: LLM-as-a-Judge Is Not an Oracle: PROCTOR guardrails (Sep 2)

items.title: OpenAgentFlow: unified AgentEvent stream with provenance and audit records (Sep 2)

items.title: AI Morbidity and Mortality: case-based clinical AI failure review framework (Sep 2)

Five illustrative cases, full agreement on all 20 axis-level classifications. Full brief.

items.title: EDGE: multi-error attribution via error-dependency graph (EMNLP 2026)

items.title: Cheap Verifiers: in-loop verifier metrics cannot see cascade degradation (Sep 1)
items.html: Rajput, arXiv 2609.01345 (submitted 1 Sep). Cascade dashboard computed through the verifier reads a flat 3% error while true delivered error swings up to 32%. Reliability of a self-improving cascade cannot be read from any metric computed through its own verifier. Full brief.

items.title: SAGE: state-grounded, abstention-aware eval of dialogue agents (Aug 31)
items.html: Khoury et al., arXiv 2609.00434 (submitted 31 Aug). Compiles a workflow spec plus per-turn state diff into atomic criteria; symbolic and encoder verifiers abstain rather than guess; emits a turn-level decision with an evidence trace. Decides 81–91% of criteria with no paid LLM call. Full brief.

items.title: Invalidation contracts for cross-episode agent memory (Aug 31)
items.html: Wu and Canedo, arXiv 2609.00243 (submitted 31 Aug). Version stamps and cacheability hints on cached recovery suggestions so agents evict stale fixes without trial and error. Identical bytes: 100% first-try compliance on one model, 11% or below on another. Full brief.

items.title: The Irreversibility Budget: fleet-level residual risk accounting (Aug 31)
items.html: Mohammadi and Bindschaedler, arXiv 2609.00275 (submitted 31 Aug). Fleet-level cumulative residual value-at-risk per principal, charged per effect at a trusted runtime. Per-effect gates admitted overdraws up to 48× the tenant risk limit. Full brief.

items.html: Mittapalli et al., arXiv 2606.07054. Triage–Inspect–Judge on SHADE-Arena (avg 91.8 turns). Claude Sonnet 4.6 F1 0.713 vs full-trajectory 0.577. Template for any BQAA judge: materialize suspect windows in SQL, persist evidence, judge the log.

items.title: DoVer: attribution is a hypothesis until you replay
items.html: Ma et al., ICLR 2026. 14/29 Who&When GAIA labels were uncertain. Interventions flip 18–28% of Magentic-One failures; end-of-trace critique flipped 0%. Gates #435: report % hypotheses validated, not judge accuracy vs a single gold step. Hook is AGENT_STATE_CHECKPOINT.

items.title: Yehudai: warehouse aggregation is the missing layer
items.html: Findings of ACL 2026 (also arXiv 2503.16416). Developer eval frameworks (LangSmith, Langfuse, Vertex, Arize) cannot derive insights across large run collections. Direct product implication for BQAA’s consume side.

items.title: SANA is not a taxonomy paper
items.html: arXiv 2606.13904. The #435 thread described a seven-category taxonomy and two-stage LLM audit on Strands. The abstract is a component-ablation over LakeQA/KramaBench (data analysis is the bottleneck). Re-read the PDF before citing as prior art.

items.title: Monday: v_tool_repeat view
items.html: Highest-EV SQL in the Fable 5 brief: group TOOL_STARTING by invocation_id, tool name, and a hash of the args, HAVING COUNT(*) > k. This is Arize’s 43× get_datasets loop with OK spans. No LLM. No #435. Ships as an SDK view.

progress.html: Fable 5: highest-EV is now deterministic session flags (loop, latency_outlier, misroute, overflow, status='ERROR') plus a non-decaying session risk latch, not v_tool_repeat alone. Full brief.

items.html: Shaikh, Bombarde, Pathak, arXiv 2608.26225 (submitted 26 Aug). 147 incidents; 54 successful identical calls invisible to error-rate breakers; effects accumulate across six invocations. Re-key v_tool_repeat on (tool, args_sha256, result_sha256), not status='ERROR'. Full brief.

items.title: Verdict Staleness: approvals expire between check and use
items.html: Shraga, Eshel, Gorelik, arXiv 2608.26306 (26 Aug; IEEE ACSOS 2026). Freshness contract: 5.3–48.4% verdict change between check and use. Ship v_approval_age; reserve checked_context_sha256, grounding_ts, expiry_rule, fallback on GUARDRAIL_DECISION. Full brief.

items.title: CTF-ABACUS: only 62–87% of successes are trace-verified
items.html: Milner, Shao, Rani et al., arXiv 2608.26237 (26 Aug). 1,435 attempts; 13–38% of matching outputs skip the required work. Add trajectory_verified beside match_golden_qa (answer matched and required tools observed). Full brief.

items.html: Lewis, arXiv 2608.26218 (26 Aug). Holding model and task fixed, a harness change moved SWE-bench Verified fail-to-pass 28% → 49%. Put ADK version, compaction policy, and EVENT_COMPACTION count on the eval manifest so fault_side = harness is populatable. Full brief.

items.title: ClawTrack: process scores filter lucky passes
items.html: Wu et al., arXiv 2607.28037 (submitted 30 Jul). Dual Task Score + Process Score; 12,541 rubric items across 320 tasks / 8 domains; result verification is the systematic bottleneck. Trajectory filtering on process scores yields post-training gains. Third independent paper in four days (after Fidelity Is Not Enough and CURA) that truth lives in the trajectory. Dual-threshold trajectory_verified beside match_golden_qa. Full brief.

items.title: AgentEval: attribution works when the schema records the edges
items.html: Guo, Wu, Yiu, arXiv 2604.23581 (submitted 26 Apr). Evaluation DAGs: LLM-judged nodes, 21-subcategory failures, upstream dependency edges. 450 cases: failure-detection recall 0.89 vs 0.41 (2.17×); dependency modeling +22 detection / +34 RCA; 72% RCA vs 81% human ceiling; 4-month pilot 4.2h → 22 min. LongRCA's 24.1% is attribution without recorded structure. Fold parent_step_id into fault_edge / fault_side. Full brief.
